answers.core: Annotations feel like they should be core, al though I don't even know whether annotations can be added through addons? That would be cool.
answers.workaround: One not-so-easy workaround I have found is to add a new export variable to a script without overwriting the old data and then write an editor tool that finds all applicable objects and manually places the data of the old exported variable into the new.

title: Add an `@exported_previously_as()` annotation to avoid losing data
